about_the_game:
Rise of the Settlement is a hand-crafted medieval production and settlement management game where every resource matters, and every decision shapes your community’s future.

Begin with just a few settlers and the barest survival tools. Forage for food, gather branches and reeds, and struggle to survive your first winter. Over time, unlock new technologies that allow your village to grow from makeshift huts into a thriving medieval settlement—with farms, quarries, drying huts, and vineyards humming with activity.

Carefully manage your people’s skills, assign them to tasks they excel at, and watch them gain experience as they work. Prioritize food, refine raw materials, and build out production chains to create advanced goods from humble beginnings.

Each building in Rise of the Settlement is more than a static structure—it can be enhanced, upgraded, or temporarily boosted with clever planning. Use technology to improve efficiency, unlock new production recipes, or expand your territory.

With a beautiful parchment-inspired UI and lovingly illustrated building and resource artwork, Rise of the Settlement invites you to build a story of growth, discovery, and medieval industry.

🏡 Key Features

  • ⚒️ Resource-Driven Production Chains
    Transform raw materials like flax and branches into usable goods through layered production buildings.

  • 👩‍🌾 Character Management
    Your villagers have names, skills, levels, and preferences. Assign them to the right jobs and watch them thrive.

  • 📜 Technological Progression
    Unlock new eras of development through a branching tech tree—from survival tools to civic advancements.

  • 🏗️ Building Enhancements
    Temporarily boost buildings with special techniques like Tied Collection, Winnowing Focus, or Row Pruning Technique.

  • 🌿 Atmospheric, Thematic Design
    A visually distinct parchment-style interface, storybook-style artwork, and meaningful seasonal changes.

  • 🛒 Trading and Exchanges
    Trade surplus resources with visiting merchants or other settlements to obtain rare goods, unlock technologies, and survive tough seasons.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2nd gen) or AMD FX-4100
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Runs on integrated graphics with low settings
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (6th gen) or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Stable at 1080p with all features enabled
